html:
During the COVID-19 pandemic, your Broadstreet team is here to help!

During the novel coronavirus pandemic, your Broadstreet team is here to help! Our entire team is working remotely and our availability has not changed.

We recommend making sure your customers are aware of any changes to your hours or services through social media updates, Google My Business updates, and specific messages added to your website. Many of our clients have done a great job getting the word out about changes to their business processes.

One of our clients, Powers & Gregory, has created radio ads and Facebook posts that talk about their low-contact policies.

Powers & Gregory technicians will: 1) Use hand sanitizer before entering your home. 2) Kindly keep a distance of 7 feet from you. If you'd prefer, you may choose to be in another room in your home while we work. 3) Sanitize anything we touch while in your home. We have always focused on healthy hygiene habits at Powers & Gregory. Every Powers & Gregory service technician keeps a bucket of cleaning supplies in his van. Now, more than ever, Powers & Gregory pledges to do everything we can to keep our customers & employees healthy. THANKS TO Wateree Ace Hardware for keeping in stock the supplies we need!

The Broadstreet team was able to help Mary Magdalene Anglican Church establish reliable live-streaming for their weekly church services.

For Laurel.edu, we helped them get more attention to their important COVID-19 message on the front page of their website.

If there is a message you need help sharing, please contact us so a member of our team can help you as quickly as possible. If you are responsible for the content on your website, please check out Marjorie’s most recent blog post on her best SEO (search engine optimization) tips that you can implement for your business now.

As for Broadstreet, we are upgrading our skills in Drupal 8 as we work to bring in new clients and upgrade the websites for existing clients. Make sure you are following us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on all things Broadstreet.

Virtually yours, Tom Sliker and the Broadstreet team
